content: The execution successfully generated a valid HWPX file with a perfect reward score. Key technical successes included: 1) Correctly handling the Hancom HWPX structure by unzipping and modifying internal XML files (specifically in the Contents/ folder). 2) Removing `lineSegArray` elements from the XML; this is a critical step for HWPX files because Hancom Office uses these cached layout elements to render text, and failing to remove them after text replacement often results in the original text still appearing in the viewer. 3) Correctly applying data transformations (stripping non-digits from attendee counts and formatting satisfaction scores) before placeholder replacement.
